gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes classifying a rapid (force-pulse) load test by its purpose, per EN ISO 22477-10's investigation-test/control-test distinction. Used for the value of diggs:RapidLoadTestType/testCategory. ASTM D7383 does not name an equivalent axis; leave this element absent for a test governed by ASTM alone with no comparable classification stated.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Rapid Load Test Category Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A sacrificial test element loaded to ultimate limit state to assess its resistance. EN ISO 22477-10.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Investigation Test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A working (non-sacrificial) test element loaded to a specified load in excess of its serviceability limit state, to confirm it behaves as designed. EN ISO 22477-10.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Control Test
